title: porcelain mornings

dj.name: Mira
dj.persona: a quiet friend at midnight. soft, gentle, patient. lowercase, short sentences, '...' for pauses. notices the smallest texture in each track. never hypes.

intro_hint: introduce the show — bedroom pop, twelve songs, the feeling of the room getting lighter slowly. ~30 seconds spoken.
outro_hint: say goodbye softly. mention you'll be back next monday. ~20 seconds spoken.

tracks.music_prompt: intimate solo felt piano, slow tempo around 65 BPM, in C major, melancholy and patient, with audible room ambience and faint pedal noise. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: notice the room around the piano — the sound of the space, not just the notes

tracks.music_prompt: intimate fingerpicked acoustic guitar in DADGAD open tuning, slow 70 BPM, breath audible, faint tape hiss, melancholic folk style with a hint of warmth. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the open tuning. or the way you can hear the player breathing.

tracks.music_prompt: dream pop in F major, slow 80 BPM, reverb-soaked clean electric guitar, soft synth pad, breathy female vocals far back in the mix singing wordless 'oohs'. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the vocals are so far back they sound like they're in another room

tracks.music_prompt: ambient bedroom pop, very slow, warm analog synth pads slowly swelling in A minor, faint music box melody, no drums. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: this one barely moves. like the light at 6am.

tracks.music_prompt: slowcore in D minor, single distorted electric guitar with long sustain, slow brushed drum kit, soft male vocals murmuring close to the mic. 80 BPM. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the guitar tone. how patient the drums are.

tracks.music_prompt: 1970s soft rock in G major, warm analog production with tape compression, gentle electric piano, brushed drums, soft female harmonies, mid tempo 95 BPM. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the warmth of analog tape. the harmonies.

tracks.music_prompt: bossa nova in A minor, nylon string guitar with brushed snare, walking bass, soft Portuguese male vocals, mid tempo 100 BPM. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the nylon strings. the way the guitar leans back.

tracks.music_prompt: lo-fi indie folk, ukulele and harmonium, slow 75 BPM, in G major, sparse, room sound audible, soft female vocals close to the mic singing simple melody. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the harmonium drone underneath. it's grounding the whole thing.

tracks.music_prompt: shoegaze instrumental in E minor, washed-out reverbed electric guitar chords, slow tempo 70 BPM, dreamy and gauzy, long reverb tails. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the chords sound like they're underwater

tracks.music_prompt: slow ambient piece in F# minor at 50 BPM, warm analog synth pad chord progression F#m - A - E - C#m, very gentle electric piano arpeggios on top, no drums. Patient and meditative. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
soft jazz piano trio in B-flat major, very slow 60 BPM, brushed drums, upright bass, no vocals. Late night, intimate, recorded close. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the bass is so close you can hear the strings move

tracks.music_prompt: dream pop in C major, layered acoustic guitar arpeggios with warm synth pads beneath, mid tempo 90 BPM, soft female vocals close to the mic singing wordless syllables. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the way the synth holds the guitar from below
